baseline: DEVX-026 is a sequential rework on top of DEVX-023 (integrated via merge 7fd55340c, accepted with the original code). The reviewer's four findings (1 MAJOR + 3 MINOR) were recorded in the prior session but not applied before integration; this attempt applies them on a fresh branch. Base commit is the tip of origin/main at dispatch time (ff3e5b147); the corpus file C:\Dev2026\Docs\.crush\crush.db.bak (757 MB, WAL mode) and the 594 task files under C:\Dev2026\Docs\tasks\ were not touched by this attempt and remain the same read-only inputs as DEVX-023. The DEVX-023 sample audit (24/24 faithful, seed 20260801) and the 19 offline assertions that the gate already validated against resultSha 707ffbc49 are preserved unchanged; this attempt extends the offline self-check from 19 to 30 assertions and proves the corpus-file invariant end-to-end against a real WAL DB.
regressions: None. The 19 prior self-check assertions still pass on the new code path. The extractor's payload shape, marker parsing, citation contract, severity labelling, rework-round capture, §1 Objetivo extraction, and drop-on-missing-citation behaviour are byte-identical to DEVX-023 (no source change in those code paths). A live URI probe and a full extractor end-to-end run against a fresh WAL DB both confirm zero -shm and zero -wal siblings appear in the DB directory. The corpus crush.db.bak was not opened by this attempt; the offline self-check uses fixtures and a temp DB inside os.tmpdir(), so this attempt cannot have written under C:\Dev2026\Docs\ even by accident.
